$note: 遷移宮（2026-10-12）：天機.遷移。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 遷移宮 p.496–515。客死異鄉、異鄉染病、官非、冤獄、被盜、意外一類斷語不用；天月、天刑、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要睇廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 見祿馬交馳，你雖然常常走動，卻多享受。
rules.en: With Lu and Tian Ma meeting, you move about often, but enjoy it.

rules.text: 同宮有火星或鈴星，你出外奔忙，不安一地。
rules.en: With Huo Xing or Ling Xing in the palace, you are always on the move, never settling in one place.

source.quote: 主出外奔忙，风露辛酸，不安一地

rules.text: 同宮有擎羊或陀羅，你在外多是非口舌。
rules.en: With Qing Yang or Tuo Luo in the palace, there is talk and dispute when you are away.

source.quote: 与羊陀同度，主是非口舌

rules.text: 天機在遷移宮，利出門離鄉發展；不一定離鄉定居，也可能是經常要離家的工作，或常轉工轉業。
rules.en: With Tian Ji in your Travel Palace, leaving home to develop suits you; not necessarily settling elsewhere, but perhaps work that keeps you travelling, or frequent changes of job.
